title: scorzoneroides crocea
intro: Scorzoneroides crocea, commonly known as Golden Ragwort, is a flowering plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Scorzoneroides crocea include acting as a demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help soothe and protect the mucous membranes, reduce pain and inflammation, and neutralize free radicals. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
